highlights: Design Studio now edits photos and vectors on one canvas, and saves editable photo layers and sketches with your project so you can reopen and change them later.
Outline text supports multilingual and right-to-left scripts. Import saved Photoshop (PSD) images, and try the experimental advanced nesting search, which can fit parts onto fewer sheets.
Edit trace parts lets you click and drag a single traced line or shape out of a large trace. Trim no longer deletes a whole line at a tangent curve, and closing a path keeps its curves intact.
Phone & MCP sits in the main toolbar with a live status dot and a quick panel for pairing, QR code and approved clients.
Saved G-code comments no longer contain characters that GRBL treats as hold, resume or status commands. Console coordinate and work-offset commands now refresh the stored reference correctly.
A purchased Pro key activates during a trial, licensed customers can find older verified installers, and switching a linked material operation from Line to Fill now picks up the recipe's settings.
